common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

intro.slide1Title: One principle a day, from the best books.
intro.slide1Body: Hill, Kiyosaki, Clear, Covey… {{count}} principles rewritten in three lines, chosen for your goal.
intro.slide1BodyNoCount: Hill, Kiyosaki, Clear, Covey… principles rewritten in three lines, chosen for your goal.
intro.slide2Title: A short exercise, adapted to your day.
intro.slide2Body: Low energy or little time? The programme adjusts every evening so you keep the rhythm.
intro.slide3Body: Each habit has its cue and its two-minute version for the hard days.

auth.signInBody: Enter your email: we'll send you a 6-digit code. No password to remember.
auth.verifyBody: We just sent it to {{email}}. Remember to check your spam folder.
auth.invalidCode: This code doesn't work or has expired. Try again or ask for a new one.
auth.tooManyRequests: Too many requests at once. Please wait a moment before trying again.
auth.network: Can't connect. Check your network and try again.

q.goalMeasure: How will you know it is achieved?
q.invalidValue: Enter a number, for example 5 or 1500.
q.deadlineInFuture: Pick a date in the future.
q.goalWhy: Why is it important to you?
q.goalWhyPlaceholder: What it will change for you…
q.blockers: What holds you back the most
q.dailyMinutes: Time available on a normal day

consent.title: Your data, your choice
consent.checkinBody: I agree to my mood and energy being recorded to adapt my plan.
consent.aiBody: I agree to a summarised, anonymised profile being processed by an AI (premium plan).
consent.note: The app stays usable without these options. You can change your mind anytime in settings.

errors.submit: Can't save right now. Your answers are kept: please try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_goal_deadline: Your goal date must be in the future.
errors.invalid_program: This program is no longer available. Please pick another one.

status.skipped: No time today: we'll adapt tomorrow.
status.too_hard: Noted: we'll suggest an easier version.

today.checkinBody: 60 seconds to take stock and prepare tomorrow.

errors.dayClosed: This day is over: the result can no longer be changed.

checkin.title: Evening check-in
checkin.subtitle: How was your day?
checkin.reflection: What brought me closer to my goal today?
checkin.savedBody: Your plan for tomorrow is ready.
checkin.tomorrowLater: Your plan for tomorrow will be ready in the morning.
checkin.shortVersion: Short version, to keep the rhythm gently.

reminders.title: A little reminder, morning and evening?
reminders.body: At {{morning}}, your exercise of the day is ready. At {{evening}}, 60 seconds for your check-in. Nothing more.
reminders.note: You can change the times in settings. The app also works without reminders.
reminders.morningBody: Your exercise of the day is ready.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.streakStart: Your streak starts with your next exercise.
progress.streakRule: One missed day doesn't break your streak: never miss twice.
progress.noData: Rates will appear after your first days.
progress.goalExpected: Orange mark: {{expected}} {{unit}} expected today on a steady path.
progress.goalInvalid: Enter a number, for example 3 or 1500.
progress.goalNoTarget: Add a target value to your goal to track your progress.
progress.noReflections: Your evening reflections will appear here.

library.title: Library
library.empty: No results: try other words or remove a filter.

errors.alreadyInPlan: This exercise is already in your day.
errors.dailyLimit: You already added 3 exercises today: that's plenty!
errors.invalid: This exercise is no longer available.

review.title: Weekly review
review.kind: Every week counts, even the lighter ones: what matters is to keep going.
review.noProposal: Nothing to adjust this week: keep it up!
review.closed: This review is over: a new one arrives on Sunday evening.
review.none: No review yet: the first one arrives on Sunday evening.

proposals.habit_simplify: Simplify "{{habit}}": switch to its minimal version ({{minimal}}).
proposals.goal_deadline: Move your goal deadline to {{date}}, at the pace you are really going.
proposals.update_goal_progress: Update your progress: we can then adjust your goal more accurately.
proposals.level_up: Move up to {{level}}: you have been above 85% for 2 weeks.
proposals.daily_minutes: Plan {{minutes}} min a day (you spend about {{average}} min).

settings.title: Settings
settings.exportBody: A JSON file with all your data, to save or share.
settings.exportError: The export failed. Please try again in a moment.
settings.deleteBody: You will have 30 days to change your mind. After that, all your data will be erased.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: Your account will be deleted in 30 days unless you cancel before then.
settings.eraseTitle: Also erase your moods and energy?
settings.eraseBody: Those already recorded can be erased. The rest of your history is kept.
settings.tooManyHabits: 6 active habits at most: deactivate one first.
settings.programConfirmBody: You will restart at day 1. Your history is kept.

deletion.title: Your account will be deleted on {{date}}
deletion.body: Until then, you can cancel the deletion or export your data. After that, everything will be erased for good.
